verses.en: But Job answered and said,
verses.pt: Então Jó respondeu:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Job made answer and said,

verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.pt: Ouvi atentamente as minhas palavras; seja isto a vossa consolação.
verses.en_web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention with care to my words; and let this be your comfort.

verses.en: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.pt: Sofrei-me, e eu falarei; e, havendo eu falado, zombai.
verses.en_web: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
verses.en_bbe: Let me say what is in my mind, and after that, go on making sport of me.

verses.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.pt: É porventura do homem que eu me queixo? Mas, ainda que assim fosse, não teria motivo de me impacientar?
verses.en_web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
verses.en_bbe: As for me, is my outcry against man? is it then to be wondered at if my spirit is troubled?

verses.en: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.pt: Olhai para mim, e pasmai, e ponde a mão sobre a boca.
verses.en_web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Take note of me and be full of wonder, put your hand on your mouth.

verses.en: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.pt: Quando me lembro disto, me perturbo, e a minha carne estremece de horror.
verses.en_web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
verses.en_bbe: At the very thought of it my flesh is shaking with fear.

verses.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.pt: Por que razão vivem os ímpios, envelhecem, e ainda se robustecem em poder?
verses.en_web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
verses.en_bbe: Why is life given to the evil-doers? why do they become old and strong in power?

verses.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.pt: Os seus filhos se estabelecem à vista deles, e os seus descendentes perante os seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
verses.en_bbe: Their children are ever with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

verses.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.pt: As suas casas estão em paz, sem temor, e a vara de Deus não está sobre eles.
verses.en_web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.en_bbe: Their houses are free from fear, and the rod of God does not come on them.

verses.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.pt: O seu touro gera, e não falha; pare a sua vaca, e não aborta.
verses.en_web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
verses.en_bbe: Their ox is ready at all times to give seed; their cow gives birth, without dropping her young.

verses.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.pt: Eles fazem sair os seus pequeninos, como a um rebanho, e suas crianças andam saltando.
verses.en_web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
verses.en_bbe: They send out their young ones like a flock, and their children have pleasure in the dance,

verses.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.pt: Levantam a voz, ao som do tamboril e da harpa, e regozijam-se ao som da flauta.
verses.en_web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
verses.en_bbe: They make songs to the instruments of music, and are glad at the sound of the pipe.

verses.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.pt: Na prosperidade passam os seus dias, e num momento descem ao Seol.
verses.en_web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: Their days come to an end without trouble, and suddenly they go down to the underworld.

verses.en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.pt: Eles dizem a Deus: retira-te de nós, pois não desejamos ter conhecimento dos teus caminhos.
verses.en_web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
verses.en_bbe: Though they said to God, Go away from us, for we have no desire for the knowledge of your ways.

verses.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.pt: Que é o Todo-Poderoso, para que nós o sirvamos? E que nos aproveitará, se lhe fizermos orações?
verses.en_web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
verses.en_bbe: What is the Ruler of all, that we may give him worship? and what profit is it to us to make prayer to him?

verses.en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.pt: Vede, porém, que eles não têm na mão a prosperidade; esteja longe de mim o conselho dos ímpios!
verses.en_web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, is not their well-being in their power? (The purpose of the evil-doers is far from me.)

verses.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.pt: Quantas vezes sucede que se apague a lâmpada dos ímpios? que lhes sobrevenha a sua destruição? que Deus na sua ira lhes reparta dores?
verses.en_web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
verses.en_bbe: How frequently is the light of the evil-doers put out, or does trouble come on them? how frequently does his wrath take them with cords?

verses.en: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.pt: que eles sejam como a palha diante do vento, e como a pragana, que o redemoinho arrebata?
verses.en_web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
verses.en_bbe: How frequently are they as dry stems before the wind, or as grass taken away by the storm-wind?

verses.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
verses.pt: Deus, dizeis vós, reserva a iniqüidade do pai para seus filhos, mas é a ele mesmo que Deus deveria punir, para que o conheça.
verses.en_web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
verses.en_bbe: You say, God keeps punishment stored up for his children. Let him send it on the man himself, so that he may have the punishment of it!

verses.en: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.pt: Vejam os seus próprios olhos a sua ruina, e beba ele do furor do Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: Let his eyes see his trouble, and let him be full of the wrath of the Ruler of all!

verses.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.pt: Pois, que lhe importa a sua casa depois de morto, quando lhe for cortado o número dos seus meses?
verses.en_web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
verses.en_bbe: For what interest has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is ended?

verses.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.pt: Acaso se ensinará ciência a Deus, a ele que julga os excelsos?
verses.en_web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
verses.en_bbe: Is anyone able to give teaching to God? for he is the judge of those who are on high.

verses.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.pt: Um morre em plena prosperidade, inteiramente sossegado e tranqüilo;
verses.en_web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.en_bbe: One comes to his end in complete well-being, full of peace and quiet:

verses.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.pt: com os seus baldes cheios de leite, e a medula dos seus ossos umedecida.
verses.en_web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
verses.en_bbe: His buckets are full of milk, and there is no loss of strength in his bones.

verses.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.pt: Outro, ao contrário, morre em amargura de alma, não havendo provado do bem.
verses.en_web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
verses.en_bbe: And another comes to his end with a bitter soul, without ever tasting good.

verses.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.pt: Juntamente jazem no pó, e os vermes os cobrem.
verses.en_web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
verses.en_bbe: Together they go down to the dust, and are covered by the worm.

verses.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.pt: Eis que conheço os vossos pensamentos, e os maus intentos com que me fazeis injustiça.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am conscious of your thoughts, and of your violent purposes against me;

verses.en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.pt: Pois dizeis: Onde está a casa do príncipe, e onde a tenda em que morava o ímpio?
verses.en_web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
verses.en_bbe: For you say, Where is the house of the ruler, and where is the tent of the evil-doer?

verses.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.pt: Porventura não perguntastes aos viandantes? e não aceitais o seu testemunho,
verses.en_web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
verses.en_bbe: Have you not put the question to the travellers, and do you not take note of their experience?

verses.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.pt: de que o mau é preservado no dia da destruição, e poupado no dia do furor?
verses.en_web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
verses.en_bbe: How the evil man goes free in the day of trouble, and has salvation in the day of wrath?

verses.en: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.pt: Quem acusará diante dele o seu caminho? e quem lhe dará o pago do que fez?
verses.en_web: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?
verses.en_bbe: Who will make his way clear to his face? and if he has done a thing, who gives him punishment for it?

verses.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.pt: Ele é levado para a sepultura, e vigiam-lhe o túmulo.
verses.en_web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.
verses.en_bbe: He is taken to his last resting-place, and keeps watch over it.

verses.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
verses.pt: Os torrões do vale lhe são doces, e o seguirão todos os homens, como ele o fez aos inumeráveis que o precederam.
verses.en_web: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
verses.en_bbe: The earth of the valley covering his bones is sweet to him, and all men come after him, as there were unnumbered before him.

verses.en: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.pt: Como, pois, me ofereceis consolações vãs, quando nas vossas respostas só resta falsidade?
verses.en_web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
verses.en_bbe: Why then do you give me comfort with words in which there is no profit, when you see that there is nothing in your answers but deceit?
